agents.name: 智能云管理 OpenAgent
agents.description: 阿里云统一的云管理 Agent，为用户提供一句话驱动的云管理体验。覆盖资源编排、Landing Zone 云环境搭建、Well-Arch五大支柱评估与架构风险识别，权限诊断与策略自动生成、跨账号统一管理等场景，同时也将与云产品的Agent集成以提供更丰富的云管理体验。小客户开箱即用，无需复杂配置即可上手；企业客户安全可控，最小权限、HITL 审批、合规基线管控、全链路可追溯。
agents.descriptionEn: AlibabaCloud’s unified Cloud Management Agent provides users with a one-sentence-driven cloud management experience. It covers scenarios such as resource orchestration, Landing Zone cloud environment setup, Well-Architected five-pillar assessment and architecture risk identification, permission diagnostics and automatic policy generation, and unified cross-account management. It also integrates with agents of cloud products to provide a richer cloud management experience. Small customers can use it out of the box and get started without complex configuration; enterprise customers benefit from secure and controllable management, with least privilege, human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval, compliance baseline control, and end-to-end traceability.

agents.descriptionEn: Elastic Compute Agent (ECAgent) is an intelligent O&M agent from Alibaba Cloud. It supports intelligent Q&A, resource querying, anomaly diagnosis, and health inspection, with collaborative features like scheduled tasks and IM integration to help you manage ECS, CS, lingjun, and more. Interact via the console or IM channels (DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu) using natural language to query instance status, diagnose issues, and run inspections — significantly boosting O&M efficiency.

agents.name: ROS AI 助手
agents.description: 面向阿里云资源编排服务（ROS）的智能助手，可根据您的需求信息，提供云架构与基础设施即代码（IaC）咨询，生成、解释、完善和校验 ROS/Terraform 模板，并协助完成资源栈操作与问题排查。

It uses your request and supported console context to answer cloud architecture and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) questions, generate, explain, refine, and validate ROS or Terraform templates, and assist with ROS stack operations and troubleshooting.

features.name: 共享模板

features.name: 模板在线编辑器

features.name: 解决方案和示例模板
features.description: ROS提供了丰富的解决方案（控制台 - 解决方案中心）和示例模板（控制台 - 模板 - 模板示例），供用户选择。

features.name: 资源栈部署和管理

features.name: 资源导入资源栈

features.name: 偏差检测
features.description: 当您在资源编排服务ROS之外更改资源配置时，可以使用偏差检测功能检测资源栈中资源的变更信息。您也可以采取纠正措施，使资源栈资源与资源栈模板中的定义同步，以确保资源配置的一致性。

features.name: 更改集
features.description: 当您需要更新正在运行的资源栈时，可以使用更改集功能。您可以预览更改对资源栈正在运行资源造成的影响，只有在您执行更改集时，ROS才会对您的资源栈进行更改，您可以使用ROS控制台、ALIYUN CLI或ROS API来创建和管理更改集。

features.name: Terraform托管
features.description: Terraform是一个开源的自动化资源编排工具。资源编排服务ROS为Terraform提供了托管的能力，您可以创建Terraform类型的模板和资源栈，编排阿里云、AWS或Azure的资源。

features.name: 资源栈组部署和管理
features.description: ROS支持通过资源栈组，批量管理资源栈。包括创建、查看、更新和删除资源栈组。

features.name: 资源栈实例部署和管理

It turns business requirements and constraints such as region, budget, performance, and high availability into comparable cloud architecture options, generates and validates ROS templates, and provides cost estimates. agents.name: 系统运维管理OOS ChatOps助手
agents.nameEn: Cloud Orchestration Service OOS ChatOps Assistant
agents.description: 「系统运维管理 OOS ChatOps 助手」是一款基于自然语言交互技术的智能运维工具，通过文字指令即可完成云资源查询、监控与操作。其核心能力包括：资源运维、监控分析、安全管理、跨平台集成等。
agents.descriptionEn: Operation Orchestration Service OOS ChatOps Assistant is an intelligent O&M tool powered by natural language interaction technology, enabling users to query, monitor, and manage cloud resources via text commands. Its core capabilities include resource O&M, monitoring and analysis, security management, and cross-platform integration.

features.name: 监控分析
features.description: 支持通过对话实时查询云资源的性能指标（如 CPU 使用率、网络流量等），自动生成可视化图表，并结合上下文给出异常检测与优化建议。
features.descriptionEn: Supports real-time querying of cloud resource performance metrics (e.g., CPU utilization, network traffic) via chat, automatically generates visual charts, and provides anomaly detection and optimization recommendations contextualized to the conversation.

features.name: 跨平台集成
features.description: 集成钉钉、企业微信机器人，支持在 PC 端与移动端统一进行运维操作，实现多平台协同、随时随地管理云资源。
features.descriptionEn: Integrates DingTalk and WeCom bots, enabling unified O&M operations across PC and mobile devices, facilitating multi-platform collaboration and cloud resource management anytime, anywhere.

features.name: 安全管理
features.description: 所有写操作（如删除实例、停止服务等）默认触发二次确认机制，结合 RAM 角色权限体系实现细粒度权限控制，确保关键操作安全可靠。
features.descriptionEn: All write operations (e.g., deleting instances, stopping services) trigger a default two-step confirmation mechanism; fine-grained permission control is enforced via the RAM role-based authorization system to ensure critical operations are secure and reliable.

features.name: 资源运维
features.description: 自动识别操作需求并调用相应 OpenAPI 完成资源创建、变更等操作，实现“自然语言驱动运维”的端到端自动化运维，支持ECS、RDS、OSS、VPC等核心产品、常规运维操作;
features.descriptionEn: Automatically identifies operational requirements and invokes corresponding OpenAPIs to perform resource creation, modification, and other tasks—enabling end-to-end automation of 'natural language–driven O&M', supporting core products including ECS, RDS, OSS, and VPC, as well as common O&M operations.

agents.name: 云防火墙安全运营 Agent
agents.description: 云防火墙安全运营 Agent，主要负责流量洞察、策略生成、策略分析等。
agents.descriptionEn: The Cloud Firewall Security Operations Agent is primarily responsible for traffic insights, policy generation, policy analysis, and more.

features.name: 流量洞察
features.description: 通过AI大模型分析用户流量画像并生成对应的日报，并给出风险修复建议。
features.descriptionEn: Uses AI large models to analyze user traffic profiles and generate daily reports, along with risk remediation recommendations.

features.name: 策略推荐
features.description: 通过AI大模型自动化分析用户流日志，根据业务流量情况给用户推荐ACL规则，帮助用户收敛业务访问风险。
features.descriptionEn: Automatically analyzes user flow logs using AI large models and recommends ACL rules based on business traffic patterns to help users mitigate business access risks.

agents.name: 云上数字网工
agents.description: 用户的专属云上数字网工，具备网络专家级知识，可定时触发、7×24 小时在线自主响应，帮助企业从"人工响应"走向"AI 驱动的智能运维"。
agents.descriptionEn: An exclusive cloud-based digital network engineer with expert knowledge. Features scheduled triggers and 24/7 autonomous response, enabling the shift from manual support to AI-driven intelligent O&M.

features.name: 企业版（月度订阅）
features.description: 定位用户的云上数字网工，具备网络专家级知识，可定时触发、7×24 小时在线自主响应，帮助企业从"人工响应"走向"AI 驱动的智能运维"。
features.descriptionEn: A cloud-based digital network engineer for users, equipped with network expert-level knowledge. It can be triggered on a schedule and operates autonomously 24/7, helping enterprises transition from "manual response" to "AI-driven intelligent operations and maintenance."

agents.name: PolarDB数据Agent
agents.description: PolarDB数据Agent，负责SQL生成，数据分析，数据处理等。
agents.descriptionEn: PolarDB Data Agent，responsible for NL2SQL，data analysis，data processing etc.

features.name: 性能洞察
features.description: PolarDB MySQL版的一键诊断融合了DAS的部分功能。您可以通过performance_schema能力汇聚SQL信息，评估目标数据库负载情况，找到性能问题的源头，提供相应的治理方案，提升数据库的稳定性。
features.descriptionEn: The one-click diagnostics feature of PolarDB for MySQL integrates certain capabilities of Database Autonomy Service (DAS). By leveraging the performance_schema, it aggregates SQL information to assess the workload of the target database, identify root causes of performance issues, and provide corresponding remediation recommendations to enhance database stability.

features.name: SQL洞察
features.description: PolarDB MySQL版的SQL洞察功能已升级为SQL洞察和审计。SQL洞察和审计由数据库自治服务DAS提供，在全量请求和安全审计的基础上，融合了搜索、SQL洞察、安全审计以及流量回放和压测等功能，帮助您更好地获取SQL语句的具体信息、排查各种性能问题、识别高危风险来源。
features.descriptionEn: The SQL Insights feature of PolarDB for MySQL has been upgraded to SQL Insights and Audit. Provided by Database Autonomy Service (DAS), SQL Insights and Audit integrates full-request tracing, security auditing, search, SQL insights, security audit, traffic replay, and stress testing—enabling you to obtain detailed SQL statement information, troubleshoot diverse performance issues, and identify high-risk sources.

agents.billingLogic: 目前按照资源计费，后面会改为Credits消耗计费

agents.name: RDS AI助手
agents.description: 「RDS AI助手」提供多轮对话与问答、数据与数据库辅助。
agents.descriptionEn: RDS Copilot provides multi-turn conversations and Q&A, as well as data and database assistance.

features.name: RDS规格
features.description: RDS的实例规格族包括共享规格、通用规格、独享规格。
features.descriptionEn: RDS instance types include shared, general-purpose, and dedicated instance families.

features.name: 存储类型
features.description: 云数据库RDS提供了以下数据存储类型：ESSD云盘、本地SSD盘、SSD云盘、通用云盘。
features.descriptionEn: ApsaraDB RDS supports the following storage types: ESSD cloud disks, local SSDs, standard SSD cloud disks, and general-purpose cloud disks.

features.name: 计算单元RCU
features.description: RDS Serverless实例以RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）表示性能，支持手动调整RCU的弹性范围，Serverless实例会在设定的最小RCU和上限RCU的范围内，根据实际业务压力自动升高或降低RCU。
features.descriptionEn: RDS Serverless instances use RDS Capacity Units (RCUs) to represent performance. RCUs can be manually adjusted within a configurable elastic range; the Serverless instance automatically scales RCUs up or down based on actual workload pressure, between the specified minimum and maximum RCU values.

features.name: 存储空间
features.description: RDS实例的存储空间，支持手动增加存储空间和设置存储空间自动扩容
features.descriptionEn: RDS instance storage capacity supports manual expansion and automatic scaling.

features.name: 弹性计算资源（CPU+IOPS）
features.description: 当业务持续发展和数据量增加、新业务或新功能上线等导致数据库流量增加、计算资源不足时，扩容数据库计算规格（CPU和内存）是一种有效的方式。
features.descriptionEn: When business growth, increasing data volume, or new features cause higher database traffic and insufficient compute resources, scaling the database compute specifications (CPU and memory) is an effective solution.

features.name: 长期备份
features.description: RDS 实例支持自动备份和手动备份两种备份方式。用户可以通过设置备份策略调整RDS数据备份和日志备份的周期实现自动备份。
features.descriptionEn: RDS instances support both automatic and manual backup methods. Users can configure backup policies to define the frequency of data and log backups for automated backups.

features.name: 异地备份空间
features.description: RDS MySQL提供了跨地域备份数据（异地备份）功能，可以自动将数据备份到另一个地域，可用于监管或容灾恢复等场景。
features.descriptionEn: RDS MySQL supports cross-region backup (also known as geo-redundant backup), automatically replicating backup data to another region for regulatory compliance or disaster recovery scenarios.

features.name: 计算包规格
features.description: 计算包是RDS推出的一种预付费资源包，可以抵扣RDS MySQL、RDS PostgreSQL、RDS SQL Server、RDS MariaDB实例的按量付费计算资源。抵扣部分不再计费，仅超出部分按小时计费。
features.descriptionEn: Compute packages are prepaid resource packages offered by RDS, applicable for offsetting pay-as-you-go compute resource costs for RDS MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MariaDB instances. Usage within the package is free of charge; only usage exceeding the package quota is billed hourly.

features.name: 存储包规格
features.description: 存储包是RDS推出的一种预付费资源包，可以抵扣RDS MySQL、RDS PostgreSQL、RDS SQL Server、RDS MariaDB的实例存储空间、备份空间（实例备份、长期备份、异地备份）和SQL审计使用量，抵扣部分不再计费，仅超出部分按小时计费。
features.descriptionEn: Storage packages are prepaid resource packages offered by RDS, applicable for offsetting storage-related usage fees—including instance storage space, backup storage (instance backups, long-term backups, and cross-region backups), and SQL audit consumption—for RDS MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MariaDB instances. Usage within the package is free of charge; only usage exceeding the package quota is billed hourly.

features.name: 数据库代理实例分片数
features.description: RDS 数据库代理是位于数据库服务端和应用服务端之间的网络代理服务，用于代理应用服务端访问数据库时的所有请求。您可以连接数据库代理访问地址使用数据库代理的各项功能，以简化数据库实例的连接管理。
features.descriptionEn: The RDS Database Proxy is a network proxy service positioned between application servers and database servers, handling all application requests to the database. You can connect to the database proxy endpoint to leverage its features and simplify database connection management.

features.name: IO突发
features.description: RDS 通用云盘支持IO突发功能,IO突发功能开启后，实例的最大IOPS将不受实例存储容量的限制。
features.descriptionEn: RDS general-purpose cloud disks support I/O bursting. When enabled, the instance’s maximum IOPS is no longer constrained by its storage capacity.

features.name: SQL审计
features.description: 在需要监控和管理RDS MySQL实例中执行的SQL语句时，可以利用SQL洞察和审计功能对SQL语句的执行情况进行记录和分析。开启该功能后会自动记录来自数据库内核的SQL语句，以及SQL语句的执行账号、IP地址、执行详情等信息。
features.descriptionEn: To monitor and manage SQL statements executed on an RDS MySQL instance, you can use SQL Insight and auditing features to record and analyze SQL execution details. Once enabled, this feature automatically captures SQL statements from the database kernel along with associated metadata such as executing account, client IP address, and execution details.

features.name: 温备写入资源
features.description: RDS MySQL异地温备，通过并发写入数，调整同步写入速度
features.descriptionEn: For RDS MySQL cross-region warm standby, write throughput synchronization speed can be adjusted via concurrent write count.

agents.billingLogic:
免费版：默认可用，支持智能问答、智能诊断、手动实例巡检等基础AI对话能力，以单次会话为主，每日对话次数有限，适合个人开发者体验与轻量使用。

标准版：在免费版全部功能的基础上，提供更大的Token算力配额，不限对话次数，并解锁智能定时巡检、智能告警订阅等自动化运维能力，AI持续纳管实例、主动发现并处理问题。当前仅支持RDS MySQL实例。

专业版：面向企业级智能运维，额外支持API调用（方便企业内部平台集成）、批量实例巡检与生态接入（如钉钉、飞书机器人接入，Web应用嵌入），有专属技术支持。专业版开通时默认会购买基础包，并支持按需加购AI容量包以扩展任务并发与算力。

agents.name: 容器服务Agent
agents.description: 容器服务 Agent 是阿里云的 AI 原生容器智能管理平台，提供覆盖集群与应用全生命周期的 7×24 小时自主智能运维能力。支持通过控制台或IM频道以自然语言提交容器服务运维任务，开启和配置自主智能运维，自定义任务和Skills技能中心。
agents.descriptionEn: Container Service Agent is Alibaba Cloud's AI-native intelligent container service management platform, providing 24/7 autonomous intelligent O&M for the full lifecycle of your clusters and applications. It supports submitting Agent O&M tasks using natural language via the console or IM channels, autonomous intelligent O&M, custom tasks, and a Skills Hub.

features.name: 智能任务对话
features.description: 基于大模型的自然语言交互式集群管理能力。用户可通过对话方式向 容器服务Agent下发运维指令，Agent自动理解意图、规划执行步骤并调用集群 API 完成任务。支持多轮对话上下文理解，可在一次会话中连续完成查询、诊断、变更等复合操作。任务执行过程中实时展示推理链路和操作结果，所有变更操作需用户确认后执行，保证客户运营环境安全。
features.descriptionEn: Natural language–based, interactive cluster management powered by large language models. Users can issue O&M commands to the Container Service Agent via conversational interfaces; the Agent automatically interprets intent, plans execution steps, and invokes cluster APIs to complete tasks. Supports multi-turn dialogue with contextual understanding, enabling compound operations—including querying, diagnostics, and configuration changes—within a single session. Real-time visualization of reasoning chains and operation results is provided during task execution, and all configuration changes require explicit user confirmation to ensure operational safety.

features.name: 智能自主运维
features.description: 基于大模型的集群智能运维能力。容器服务Agent可自动分析集群事件、告警和日志，对异常进行根因定位并给出修复建议，支持自然语言交互式排障（如 Pod 启动失败诊断、节点 NotReady 排查、资源水位分析等）。从被动响应转为主动发现+智能决策，降低运维门槛和 MTTR。
features.descriptionEn: Cluster-level intelligent O&M powered by large language models. The Container Service Agent automatically analyzes cluster events, alerts, and logs to identify root causes of anomalies and recommends remediation actions. Supports natural language–based troubleshooting (e.g., diagnosing Pod startup failures, investigating NotReady nodes, analyzing resource utilization trends). Shifts operations from reactive response to proactive detection and intelligent decision-making, lowering operational complexity and reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR).

features.name: 定时任务
features.description: 支持用户配置周期性或一次性自动化任务，容器服务Agent 按调度计划自动执行。典型场景包括：定时巡检集群健康状态并推送报告、定时清理过期资源（如已完成 Job、旧 ReplicaSet）、定时采集集群成本与资源使用趋势。任务执行结果可通过 IM 频道或钉钉通知推送，实现无人值守的周期性运维。
features.descriptionEn: Supports configuration of recurring or one-time automated tasks, executed by the Container Service Agent according to predefined schedules. Typical use cases include: periodic health checks with report delivery, automatic cleanup of expired resources (e.g., completed Jobs, obsolete ReplicaSets), and scheduled collection of cost and resource usage trends. Task execution results can be pushed via IM channels or DingTalk notifications, enabling fully unattended periodic operations.

features.name: 技能中心
features.description: 容器服务Agent的可扩展技能中心，提供自定义的运维技能（Skill）支持。每个技能封装一套完整的操作 SOP 和工具链，覆盖常见运维场景，如集群升级预检、节点池弹性伸缩策略、安全合规扫描、日志分析等。用户可按需安装技能，也可根据自身运维流程创建自定义技能，实现 Agent 能力的持续扩展和团队知识沉淀。
features.descriptionEn: An extensible skill center for the Container Service Agent, supporting customizable O&M skills (Skills). Each skill encapsulates a complete standard operating procedure (SOP) and associated toolchain for common operational scenarios—such as pre-upgrade cluster validation, node pool auto-scaling policies, security and compliance scanning, and log analysis. Users can install out-of-the-box skills or author custom skills aligned with their internal O&M workflows, enabling continuous expansion of Agent capabilities and institutional knowledge retention.

features.name: IM频道
features.description: 将容器服务Agent 能力接入钉钉、飞书等即时通讯平台的通道能力。用户可在IM 群聊中直接与Agent 对话，执行集群查询、触发运维操作、接收告警通知和任务结果推送。支持多集群统一入口管理，运维团队无需切换控制台即可在协作群内完成日常运维，实现"运维即聊天"的协作体验。
features.descriptionEn: Integration channel enabling the Container Service Agent to operate within instant messaging platforms such as DingTalk and Feishu. Users can directly interact with the Agent in group chats to query cluster status, trigger O&M actions, receive alert notifications, and view task results. features.descriptionEn: Provides intelligent runtime diagnostics for Java applications—parsing heap dumps, GC logs, thread dumps, and other diagnostic data—to directly surface underlying issues and tuning recommendations, eliminating the need for deep JVM expertise.

features.name: 发行版服务
features.description: OS 领域 AI Native 的发行版服务原子能力，覆盖选型引入、构建打包、CVE/BUG 修复、异构适配、发布交付全链路，把发行版研发从"人工编码"变为"AI 执行 + 人工审核"。
features.descriptionEn: An AI-native, atomic distribution service capability for the OS domain—covering selection and onboarding, build and packaging, CVE/bug fixes, heterogeneous adaptation, and release delivery—transforming distribution development from 'manual coding' to 'AI execution + human review'.

features.name: OS安全服务
features.description: 为运维与安全工程师提供 OS 层安全"明白账"与漏洞快速响应——基于 Alinux 安全规则知识库 + 分钟级威胁判定 + 内核热缓解，一句话查清哪几台有风险，战时分钟级拿到免重启修复方案。
features.descriptionEn: Provides operations and security engineers with clear, actionable OS-layer security visibility and rapid vulnerability response—leveraging the Alibaba Linux security rule knowledge base, minute-level threat assessment, and kernel hot mitigation—to instantly identify affected hosts and deliver restart-free remediation plans within minutes during critical incidents.

agents.billingLogic: 按Credits消耗/资源包计费，按照1 Credit = ¥0.05 = 5,723 Token

openApiConfigs.apiTitle: 请求os copilot服务流式sse接口
openApiConfigs.apiTitleEn: Request OS copilot streaming SSE service
openApiConfigs.apiDescriptionEn: Provides a streaming SSE interface for the OS Copilot service.

agents.name: 小PAI
agents.description: Agentic PAI是基于对话式的AI全链路开发平台，让用户通过自然语言完成在PAI上的复杂操作，将传统的"多页面、多步骤、多工具"操作模式，收敛为"一个对话框、一句话搞定"，把时间还给真正的 AI 开发。
agents.descriptionEn: Agentic PAI is a conversational, full-lifecycle AI development platform that lets users carry out complex operations on PAI through natural language. It collapses the traditional "multiple pages, multiple steps, multiple tools" workflow into a single chat box — just say what you want — so that time goes back to what really matters: AI development itself.

features.name: 工作空间计算资源管理
features.description: 工作空间管理员可将当前账号拥有的AI计算资源关联至当前工作空间，供工作空间成员做开发训练使用。
features.descriptionEn: Workspace administrators can associate AI computing resources owned by the current account with the workspace, enabling workspace members to use them for development and training.

features.name: 云原生开发环境
features.description: 为用户提供灵活、稳定、易用和高性能的AI开发环境，支持基于CPU/GPU的多种模型开发训练实例规格。
features.descriptionEn: Provides users with a flexible, stable, user-friendly, and high-performance AI development environment, supporting multiple instance types for model development and training based on CPU/GPU.

features.name: 云原生分布式训练环境
features.description: 基于阿里巴巴容器服务为用户提供灵活、稳定、易用和极致性能的深度学习训练环境，基于（CPU/GPU）提供深度学习训练平台。
features.descriptionEn: Built on Alibaba Cloud Container Service, provides users with a flexible, stable, user-friendly, and ultra-high-performance deep learning training environment, offering a deep learning training platform based on CPU/GPU.

features.name: 资源组管理
features.description: EAS将集群资源分为不同的资源组进行隔离。新建模型服务时，您可以选择将模型服务部署在公共资源组或自己创建的专属资源组。
features.descriptionEn: EAS isolates cluster resources into different resource groups. When creating a model service, you can choose to deploy it in either a public resource group or a dedicated resource group you created.

features.name: 工作空间消息通知
features.description: PAI工作空间为您提供了消息通知机制，您可以创建消息通知规则，实现对DLC任务或PAIFlow（PAI-Designer）任务状态的跟踪和监控，或是基于AI资产管理-模型版本准入状态变化触发下游事件。
features.descriptionEn: PAI Workspace provides a notification mechanism. You can create notification rules to track and monitor DLC or PAIFlow (PAI-Designer) task statuses, or trigger downstream events based on changes in model version admission status in AI Asset Management.

features.name: DSW Gallery
features.description: DSW Gallery可以为广大AI开发者提供来自各个行业和技术方向的简单易用、一键启动的案例，助力用户有效提升开发效率。
features.descriptionEn: DSW Gallery offers easy-to-use, one-click launch AI modeling examples across industries and technical domains, helping users significantly improve development efficiency.

features.name: 数据集挂载
features.description: 支持多数据集，可以同时挂载多个NAS、OSS数据集。
features.descriptionEn: Supports multiple datasets and allows simultaneous mounting of multiple NAS and OSS datasets.

features.name: 服务/应用部署
features.description: EAS支持将从开源社区下载的模型或您自己训练获得的模型部署为推理服务或AI-Web应用。针对不同方式获取的训练模型，PAI-EAS支持不同的部署方式，您可以使用PAI-EAS的控制台方式快速将其部署为API服务。
features.descriptionEn: EAS supports deploying models downloaded from open-source communities or models trained by you as inference services or AI web applications. For models obtained through different methods, PAI-EAS offers corresponding deployment options, allowing you to quickly deploy them as API services via the PAI-EAS console.

features.name: 工作空间存储及SLS转发设置
features.description: 工作空间管理员可以配置当前工作空间下开发训练的默认存储路径，或临时表的存储生命周期。
features.nameEn: Workspace Storage and SLS Forwarding Configuration
features.descriptionEn: Workspace administrators can configure the default storage path for development and training within the workspace, or set the lifecycle for temporary tables.

features.name: 公共/专有资源组
features.description: 支持公共资源组与专有资源组。
features.descriptionEn: Supports both public and dedicated resource groups.

features.name: 服务调试与压测
features.description: 服务部署完成后，您可以使用在线调试/压测功能来测试服务是否运行正常。
features.descriptionEn: After service deployment, you can use online debugging and load testing features to verify normal service operation.

features.name: 成员及权限管理
features.description: 基于角色的访问控制，提供标注管理员、算法开发、算法运维等AI全链路多角色支持用户高效协同。工作空间内AI资产支持private/public属性，且面向不同角色提供不同访问权限。
features.descriptionEn: Role-based access control (RBAC) supports full AI lifecycle roles—including annotation administrator, algorithm developer, and algorithm operations—enabling efficient collaboration. AI assets within the workspace support private/public attributes, with differentiated access permissions assigned per role.

features.name: JupyterLab
features.description: DSW集成了开源JupyterLab，并以插件化的形式进行深度定制化开发。无需任何运维配置，即可进行Notebook编写、调试及运行Python代码。
features.descriptionEn: DSW integrates open-source JupyterLab and extends it via plugin-based deep customization. Users can write, debug, and run Python code in notebooks without any operational configuration.

features.name: 官方镜像/自定义镜像
features.description: 支持使用官方镜像或自定义镜像提交训练任务。
features.descriptionEn: Supports submitting training jobs using official or custom Docker images.

features.name: 服务监控与报警
features.description: 服务部署成功后，您可以在服务监控页面查看该服务的相关指标，来了解服务的调用及运行情况。如果服务运行情况超过了配置的报警规则（条件），则发送报警通知。
features.descriptionEn: After successful service deployment, you can view related metrics on the service monitoring page to understand invocation and runtime behavior. Alerts are triggered when monitored metrics exceed configured alert thresholds.

features.name: WebIDE
features.description: 提供WebIDE建模环境，可以自由安装社区开源插件。
features.descriptionEn: Provides a WebIDE modeling environment supporting free installation of community open-source plugins.

features.name: 分布式训练
features.description: 支持数据并行、模型并行及混合并行的分布式方案。
features.descriptionEn: Supports distributed training strategies including data parallelism, model parallelism, and hybrid parallelism.

features.name: 服务弹性伸缩
features.description: 支持用户配置水平自动扩缩容、定时自动扩缩容、弹性资源池等能力。
features.descriptionEn: Supports horizontal auto-scaling, scheduled auto-scaling, and elastic resource pools.

features.name: 工作空间调度中心
features.description: 调度中心提供了工作空间维度的资源管理和调度机制，支持管理员根据不同的业务需求和使用场景，灵活进行资源调度配置。
features.descriptionEn: The scheduler provides workspace-level resource management and scheduling mechanisms, enabling administrators to flexibly configure resource scheduling according to varying business requirements and usage scenarios.

features.name: Terminal
features.description: 提供字符终端，方便模型调试。
features.descriptionEn: Provides a command-line terminal for convenient model debugging.

features.name: 训练任务管理
features.description: 任务生命周期管理，任务全流程把控。
features.descriptionEn: End-to-end lifecycle management and full-process control of training jobs.

features.name: 服务调用
features.description: EAS根据客户端所在的网络环境不同，提供公网访问、VPC访问、VPC高速直连访问三种不同的服务调用方法。
features.descriptionEn: EAS provides three invocation methods—public network access, VPC access, and high-speed VPC direct connection—depending on the client’s network environment.

features.name: 工作空间管理
features.description: 提供页面及OpenAPI支持用户对工作空间进行增删改查等管理操作。
features.descriptionEn: Provides both UI and OpenAPI support for CRUD operations on workspaces.

features.name: 实例环境持久化
features.description: 支持用户进行开发环境生命周期管理、实例环境保存、数据挂载共享、环境镜像持久化等功能。
features.descriptionEn: Supports development environment lifecycle management, instance environment saving, shared data mounting, and environment image persistence.

features.name: 分布式训练能力被集成
features.description: 提供标准OpenAPI，支持被集成。
features.descriptionEn: Provides standard OpenAPIs for integration.

features.name: 异步推理
features.description: EAS提供异步推理服务，支持通过订阅或轮询的方式来获取推理结果。
features.descriptionEn: EAS provides asynchronous inference services, supporting result retrieval via subscription or polling.

features.name: 资源水位监控
features.description: 实时资源水位可视化查看。
features.descriptionEn: Real-time visualization of resource utilization.

features.name: 监控和报警
features.description: DLC支持查看并监控任务资源状况，并且提供了全面详细的监控指标，帮助您更好地掌握资源负载情况。通过监控报警功能，您可以对DLC分布式训练任务的资源水位进行实时监控，并灵活地配置报警规则和报警通知。如果资源水位出现波动，例如低于GPU使用率超过设定阈值，则会发送报警通知。
features.descriptionEn: DLC supports real-time monitoring of job resource usage and provides comprehensive metrics to help users better understand resource load. With monitoring and alerting, users can configure custom alert rules and notifications for resource utilization (e.g., GPU usage exceeding threshold), triggering alerts upon violations.

features.name: 资源组及服务管理能力被集成
features.description: 提供标准OpenAPI/SDK，支持被集成。
features.nameEn: Integrated Resource Group and Service Management
features.descriptionEn: Provides standard OpenAPIs and SDKs for integration.

features.name: 制作镜像
features.description: 支持用户将开发环境制作成ACR镜像，用于后续的分布式训练或者推理。
features.descriptionEn: Supports converting development environments into ACR images for subsequent distributed training or inference tasks.

features.name: SSH远程连接
features.description: 为了满足更灵活的SSH使用需求，DSW提供了两种SSH连接方案：直连方式和ProxyClient方式。您可以综合考虑两种连接方式的资源依赖、使用方式和使用限制等因素，选择适合您需求的连接方式。
features.descriptionEn: To meet diverse SSH usage needs, DSW offers two connection methods: direct connection and ProxyClient. Users can select the appropriate method based on resource dependencies, usage patterns, and constraints.

features.name: 实例管理能力被集成
features.description: 提供标准OpenAPI/SDK，支持被集成。
features.descriptionEn: Provides standard OpenAPIs and SDKs for integration.

features.name: 灵骏智算资源
features.description: 灵骏智算资源是阿里云PAI提供的大规模高密度计算资源服务，为您提供高性能AI训练、高性能计算所需的异构计算算力服务，可用于PAI的训练任务。
features.descriptionEn: Lingjun Intelligent Computing Resources is a large-scale, high-density computing service provided by Alibaba Cloud PAI, delivering heterogeneous compute power for high-performance AI training and HPC workloads, usable for PAI training jobs.

features.name: 通用训练资源
features.description: 通用训练资源是基于阿里巴巴容器服务ACK（Alibaba Cloud Container Service for Kubernetes）的深度学习训练资源，为您提供灵活、稳定、易用和高性能的深度学习训练环境。
features.descriptionEn: General-purpose training resources are deep learning training resources built on Alibaba Cloud Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK), providing a flexible, stable, user-friendly, and high-performance deep learning training environment.

features.name: 其他大数据计算资源
features.description: 展示当前用户拥有的MaxCompute、Flink等大数据计算资源。
features.descriptionEn: Displays the user’s currently available MaxCompute, Flink, and other big data compute resources.

features.name: 资源配额
features.description: 在资源池中购买资源后，可以通过创建资源配额或调整现有配额规模，来有效分配和管理资源。
features.descriptionEn: After purchasing resources in a resource pool, users can effectively allocate and manage resources by creating or adjusting resource quotas.

features.name: 服务专属网关
features.description: 为客户提供自己的专属网关，支持配置专有网络vpc、交换机及网段的白名单，配置公网的访问白名单。同时大幅提升客户在高并发和高吞吐业务场景的稳定性。
features.descriptionEn: Provides customers with a dedicated gateway supporting VPC, vSwitch, and CIDR whitelist configurations, as well as public network access whitelists—significantly enhancing stability for high-concurrency and high-throughput business scenarios.

agents.billingLogicEn: This Agent is free to use. However, the underlying cloud product resources used by the Agent (such as provisioned instances and storage) are still billed according to the pricing rules of the corresponding products.

agents.name: DAS Agent
agents.description: 「DAS Agent」提供Agent自驱动与数据库运维诊断；面向数据库智能运维和安全的 Agent，支持主动架构治理、故障智能诊断、深度 SQL 优化。
agents.descriptionEn: DAS Agent provides multi-turn conversations and database operations assistance. As an Agent for intelligent database operations and security, it supports proactive architecture governance, intelligent fault diagnosis, and advanced SQL optimization.
agents.billingLogic: 按照版本和纳管实例数收费：参考https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/3033551.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-3033504.d_0_1_1.42da4915RvnPqD
agents.billingLogicEn: This is a paid Agent. For detailed rates, see the Agent billing documentation. The underlying cloud product resources used by the Agent (such as provisioned instances and storage) are still billed according to the pricing rules of the corresponding products.

openApiConfigs.apiDescription: DAS大模型能力异步逻辑接口
openApiConfigs.apiDescriptionEn: Invokes the asynchronous logic interface for the large language model capabilities of Database Autonomy Service (DAS).

agents.name: DataWorks Data Agent
agents.description: DataWorks 平台内一站式 AI 智能助手，可通过自然语言完成数据集成、开发、治理和分析任务
agents.descriptionEn: A one-stop AI assistant in DataWorks that completes data integration, development, governance, and analysis tasks through natural language.
agents.subCategoryName: 大数据开发治理平台 DataWorks

features.name: SQL查询
features.description: 支持您通过SQL语句对MaxCompute、EMR Hive、Hologres等数据源的数据进行查询与分析，查询结果支持保存为增强分析卡片及报告、保存为电子表格、下载到本地文件等操作。
features.descriptionEn: Allows you to query and analyze data from data sources such as MaxCompute, EMR Hive, and Hologres using SQL statements. Query results can be saved as enhanced analytical cards and reports, exported as spreadsheets, or downloaded to local files.

features.name: 质量大盘
features.description: 展示当前工作空间下，需要重点关注的数据质量总览指标、实例运行后触发的质量规则校验状态的趋势及分布情况、TOP质量问题表及质量问题责任人、质量规则覆盖保障情况等。
features.descriptionEn: Displays an overview of key data quality metrics requiring attention within the current workspace, trends and distributions of quality rule validation statuses triggered after instance execution, top problematic tables and their responsible owners, and coverage status of quality rules.

features.name: API开发
features.description: 支持通过向导模式或脚本模式生成API，向导模式支持可视化的配置API。脚本模式下，可自行编写API的查询SQL，支持多表关联、复杂查询和聚合函数等功能。
features.descriptionEn: Supports API generation via wizard mode or script mode. Wizard mode provides visual API configuration. In script mode, users can write custom SQL queries for APIs, supporting multi-table joins, complex queries, and aggregate functions.

features.name: 审批策略管理
features.description: 通过圈定审批对象范围、定义审批流程来定义对关键数据资源与敏感行为的管控流程，同时提供短信、邮件、钉钉的方式发送通知。
features.descriptionEn: Defines governance workflows for critical data resources and sensitive operations by specifying approval scopes and defining approval processes. Supports notifications via SMS, email, and DingTalk.

features.name: 工作空间配置
features.description: 对空间基本属性、调度属性（是否启用调度、出错重试次数）、安全设置（限制查询条数、绑定沙箱白名单）、绑定计算引擎进行操作。
features.descriptionEn: Manages basic workspace properties, scheduling properties (e.g., enabling scheduling, retry count on failure), security settings (e.g., limiting query row count, sandbox whitelist binding), and bound computing engines.

features.name: 目录管理
features.description: 管理代码文件、任务节点、工作流等内容，包含项目目录、个人目录。
features.descriptionEn: Manages code files, task nodes, workflows, and other content, including project directories and personal directories.

features.name: 安全概览
features.description: 提供用户待办任务指引，安全风险事件趋势，数据资产的安全状态统计。
features.descriptionEn: Provides guidance on pending user tasks, trends of security risk events, and statistical summaries of data assets’ security status.

features.name: 开发者后台
features.description: 可查看开放平台的所有功能模块、切换开放平台的使用地域、或查看开放平台的典型应用场景。
features.descriptionEn: Allows viewing all functional modules of the Open Platform, switching the region used by the Open Platform, or reviewing typical application scenarios of the Open Platform.

features.name: API管理
features.description: 提供已发布、已授权及获得授权的API列表，并支持对API进行下线、测试、授权、协议变更、查看详情页等操作。
features.descriptionEn: Provides lists of published, authorized, and granted APIs, and supports operations including deactivation, testing, authorization, protocol updates, and detailed view access.

features.name: 电子表格
features.description: 支持您通过电子表格大屏查看SQL查询结果或者手动编辑数据保存在电子表格中，支持电子表格的数据进行在线分享。
features.descriptionEn: Enables viewing SQL query results or manually editing data in spreadsheet dashboards, and supports online sharing of spreadsheet data.

features.name: 质量规则配置
features.description: 可支持按数据源类型中的单表或按规则模板进行质量规则配置，对配置后的规则可以进行订阅管理、修改、启停、关联调度和强弱类型设置等相关操作，支持固定值、环比、1天、7天、30天波动率等多种校验方式、支持动态阈值校验。
features.descriptionEn: Supports configuring quality rules either per single table within a data source type or based on rule templates. Configured rules support subscription management, modification, enabling/disabling, scheduling association, and severity-level settings. Supports multiple validation methods including fixed-value, sequential comparison, and volatility rates over 1-day, 7-day, and 30-day windows, as well as dynamic threshold validation.

features.name: 申请记录
features.description: 支持对已提交过的申请单、已审批过的申请单进行回溯查询。
features.descriptionEn: Supports retrospective queries of submitted and approved applications.

features.name: 数据源管理
features.description: 提供数据源管理页面，支持将数据库或数据仓库创建为DataWorks的数据源，并将该数据源绑定至DataWorks相应的功能模块使用。
features.descriptionEn: Provides a data source management interface, enabling databases or data warehouses to be registered as DataWorks data sources and bound to corresponding DataWorks functional modules.

features.name: 节点开发
features.description: 提供多种节点以满足不同数据处理需求：数据集成节点用于同步，引擎计算节点（如MaxCompute SQL、Hologres SQL、EMR Hive）用于数据清洗，通用节点（如虚拟节点和do-while循环节点）用于复杂逻辑处理。
features.descriptionEn: Offers various node types to meet diverse data processing needs: data integration nodes for synchronization; compute engine nodes (e.g., MaxCompute SQL, Hologres SQL, EMR Hive) for data cleansing; and generic nodes (e.g., virtual nodes and do-while loop nodes) for complex logic processing.

features.name: 数据访问控制权限
features.description: 用户通过DataWorks申请数据库/表/列的权限（已覆盖MaxCompute、DLF 1.0、Hologres、Starrocks、Hive），由管理员审批通过后完成授权。支持用户查看申请记录、管理员查看审批记录和权限审计。
features.descriptionEn: Users apply for database/table/column permissions (supported for MaxCompute, DLF 1.0, Hologres, StarRocks, and Hive) through DataWorks, with approvals granted by administrators. Supports viewing application records, approval records, and permission audits.

features.name: 可视化卡片和报告
features.description: 支持在线将数据查询结果保存为数据卡片和报告，支持定时更新卡片数据，轻松打造个性化可视化作品，讲述数据故事、表达数据观点。
features.descriptionEn: Supports saving online data query results as visual cards and reports, with scheduled card data refreshes, enabling easy creation of personalized visualizations to tell data stories and express data insights.

features.name: 元数据管控
features.description: 支持对数据地图中进行功能模块、项目、表三个级别的元数据权限管控，可管控配置元数据的查看权限。
features.descriptionEn: Supports metadata permission control at three levels—functional module, project, and table—within the Data Map, allowing configuration of metadata visibility permissions.

features.name: 质量校验任务查询
features.description: 可通过质量校验任务列表，查看已运行的质量校验任务的清单及任务详情。并可对历史结果查看和问题数据进行查看，支持用户进行问题处理，记录问题处理过程。
features.descriptionEn: Allows viewing executed quality validation tasks and their details via a task list. Supports reviewing historical results and problematic data, and enables issue handling with process documentation.

features.name: 待我审批
features.description: 查看所有待审批的申请记录。
features.descriptionEn: Displays all application records awaiting your approval.

features.name: 计算资源
features.description: 提供计算资源管理页面，支持用户将数据仓库、计算引擎、实时分析引擎等绑定为计算资源，绑定成功的计算资源才可在工作空间内使用
features.descriptionEn: Provides a computing resource management interface, enabling users to bind data warehouses, computing engines, and real-time analytics engines as computing resources. Only successfully bound resources are usable within the workspace.

features.name: 工作流
features.description: Workflow是一种数据处理流程自动化管理工具，它通过可视化拖拽方式整合多种类型的子任务节点，便捷地建立任务依赖关系，加速数据处理流程的搭建，有效提升任务开发效率。
features.descriptionEn: A workflow is an automated data processing pipeline management tool that visually integrates various subtask node types via drag-and-drop, simplifies dependency configuration, accelerates pipeline setup, and improves development efficiency.

features.name: 高危行为管控
features.description: 对高危行为（例如，下载）进行管控处理，处理方式支持：拒绝、告警、触发审批流。用户可以通过扩展程序自定义高危行为进行管控。
features.descriptionEn: Controls high-risk behaviors (e.g., downloads) with response options including rejection, alerting, or triggering approval workflows. Users can customize high-risk behavior controls via extensions.

features.name: 数据类目及专辑
features.description: 支持在数据地图的配置管理页面，配置类目导航，便于用户从业务视角进行元数据查找。同时支持元数据详情的查看。
features.descriptionEn: Supports configuring category navigation in the Data Map’s administration page to facilitate business-oriented metadata discovery. Also supports viewing metadata details.

features.name: 质量告警订阅
features.description: 支持多种质量告警订阅渠道，支持通过邮件、短信、钉钉群机器人、企业微信机器人、飞书群机器人等方式接收质量告警。
features.descriptionEn: Supports multiple alert subscription channels, including email, SMS, DingTalk group bots, WeCom group bots, and Feishu group bots.

features.name: 审批记录
features.description: 查看当前账号下所有已审批完成的申请记录。
features.descriptionEn: Displays all application records approved under the current account.

features.name: Notebook
features.description: Notebook提供了一个交互式、灵活且可复用的数据处理和分析环境，增强了直观性、模块化和交互性，帮助用户更轻松地进行数据处理、探索、可视化和模型构建。
features.descriptionEn: Notebook provides an interactive, flexible, and reusable environment for data processing and analysis, enhancing intuitiveness, modularity, and interactivity to simplify data processing, exploration, visualization, and model building.

features.name: 风险检测
features.description:
根据用户一系列的操作行为，识别和判定潜在的数据泄露风险，并标记为风险事件。
支持用户启用/停用系统预置的风险检测项；
支持用户自定义风险检测项，设置检测和通知规则；
features.descriptionEn: Identifies and flags potential data leakage risks based on user activity patterns. Supports enabling/disabling system-provided risk detection items and customizing detection items with configurable detection and notification rules.

features.name: 数据洞察
features.description: 通过深度数据分析和解读来获取深刻的数据理解和发现，支持数据探索和可视化。用户可以通过数据洞察了解数据分布，创建数据卡片，并组合成数据报告。此外，数据洞察结果能够通过长图形式的报告进一步分享。该功能利用AI技术辅助数据分析，帮助用户解析复杂数据，并为业务决策提供支持。
features.descriptionEn: Delivers deep data understanding and discoveries through advanced analysis and interpretation, supporting data exploration and visualization. Users can examine data distributions, create data cards, compose reports, and share insights via long-image reports. Leverages AI to assist in analyzing complex data and supporting business decisions.

features.name: API调用及鉴权
features.description: 支持两种API调用时的鉴权方式，其一是通过AppCode进行简单身份认证，其二是通过AppKey和AppSecret进行加密签名身份认证，极大地保障了您数据共享的安全性。
features.descriptionEn: Supports two authentication methods for API invocation: simple identity verification via AppCode, and encrypted signature-based authentication via AppKey and AppSecret—ensuring secure data sharing.

features.name: 数据血缘
features.description: 支持不同元数据对象的血缘关系展示，可重点查看表和表、字段与字段之间数据流动的血缘关系展示
features.descriptionEn: Displays lineage relationships among different metadata objects, especially highlighting data flow between tables and between fields.

features.name: 质量规则模板库
features.description: 支持通过统一管理自定义规则，形成自建的规则模板库，可提升规则配置的效率。
features.descriptionEn: Supports centralized management of custom rules to build a self-maintained rule template library, improving rule configuration efficiency.

features.name: 报警设置
features.description: 通过报警资源页面，查看当前账号指定地域下的报警资源，并设置每日报警短信和电话数量的上限
features.descriptionEn: View alert resources for the current account in the specified region via the alert resources page, and configure daily limits for alert SMS messages and phone calls.

features.name: 调度配置
features.description: 项目目录区的节点及工作流往往都是需要周期性调度的，支持用户在节点或工作流的调度配置面板配置调度相关属性，包括调度周期、调度依赖、调度参数等。
features.descriptionEn: Nodes and workflows in the project directory typically require periodic scheduling. Users can configure scheduling attributes—including schedule frequency, dependencies, and parameters—via the scheduling configuration panel.

features.name: 数据分类分级
features.description:
支持用户设置数据分类分级的模板，自定义分类结构和分级规则；
支持用户设置每个敏感数据类型的识别规则。
features.descriptionEn: Supports defining classification and grading templates, customizing classification structures and grading rules; and setting identification rules for each sensitive data type.

features.name: Notebook
features.description: Notebook提供了一个交互式、灵活且可复用的数据处理和分析环境，增强了直观性、模块化和交互性，帮助用户更轻松地进行数据处理、探索、可视化和模型构建。
features.descriptionEn: Notebook provides an interactive, flexible, and reusable environment for data processing and analysis, enhancing intuitiveness, modularity, and interactivity to simplify data processing, exploration, visualization, and model building.

features.name: API计量
features.description: 支持对已发布至网关的API进行调用计量，提供近7日累计总调用次数和总调用时长的总计数据，以及各API的明细计量数据。
features.descriptionEn: Supports invocation metering for APIs published to the gateway, providing aggregated metrics for total invocations and total invocation duration over the past seven days, as well as detailed metering data per API.

features.name: 数据管理
features.description: 支持对表的生命周期、负责人、表和字段的描述进行修改；可进行表的收藏和查看。
features.descriptionEn: Supports modifying table lifecycle, owner, and descriptions for tables and columns; and allows bookmarking and viewing tables.

features.name: 质量报告
features.description: 质量报告管理页面支持动态配置报告模板关注的质量指标，并根据配置的报告模板定时生成并发送报告。
features.descriptionEn: The quality report management page supports dynamically configuring report templates to monitor specific quality metrics and automatically generating and delivering reports based on those templates.

features.name: 租户成员与角色管理
features.description: 对该空间执行成员增/删/改的相关操作。
features.descriptionEn: Performs member add/delete/update operations for this workspace.

features.name: 节点/工作流发布
features.description: 在Data Studio完成数据开发以及调度依赖配置后，支持用户将任务发布到开发环境和生产环境，使其在开发环境及生产环境下运行。
features.descriptionEn: After completing data development and scheduling dependency configuration in Data Studio, users can publish tasks to both development and production environments for execution.

features.name: 敏感数据识别
features.description:
支持用户构建敏感数据识别任务，对指定范围的数据资产进行敏感数据识别；
支持周期性任务和单次任务；
支持用户查看识别结果的详情和敏感数据的分布；
支持用户通过修订的方式调整敏感数据识别结果；
features.descriptionEn: Supports creating sensitive data identification tasks to scan designated data assets; supports recurring and one-time tasks; enables viewing identification result details and sensitive data distribution; and allows refining identification results via manual revision.

features.name: 数据目录
features.description: 支持OpenLake湖仓一体架构，实现统一元数据管理，建表方式多样化，辅助智能建表，提升数据研发效率，满足不同类型用户多样化元数据创建及管理的需求。
features.descriptionEn: Supports the OpenLake lakehouse architecture for unified metadata management, offers diverse table creation methods, assists intelligent table creation, enhances data R&D efficiency, and meets varied metadata creation and management needs across user types.

features.name: 智能助手
features.description: 支持在用户在数据开发中使用DataWorks Copilot。
features.descriptionEn: Supports using DataWorks Copilot during data development.

features.name: 元数据详情
features.description: 支持对数据地图中包含的数据对象进行详情信息查看，可查看多维度的技术元数据和业务元数据信息。
features.descriptionEn: Supports viewing detailed information for data objects in the Data Map, including multidimensional technical and business metadata.

features.name: 敏感数据保护
features.description:
提供3大类脱敏方案：DataWorks动态脱敏、DataWorks静态脱敏、引擎层脱敏。
DataWorks动态脱敏：用户在DataWorks数据地图、数据分析、数据开发过程中，访问敏感数据时只能查看脱敏后的数据。原始数据未脱敏。
DataWorks静态脱敏：用户在DataWorks数据集成时，对敏感数据进行脱敏后存储。
引擎层脱敏：直接使用引擎的脱敏策略（例如MaxCompute的脱敏策略），用
features.descriptionEn:
Provides three categories of data masking solutions: DataWorks dynamic masking, DataWorks static masking, and engine-layer masking.
DataWorks dynamic masking: Users see only masked data when accessing sensitive data in DataWorks Data Map, Data Analysis, or Data Development; original data remains unmasked.
DataWorks static masking: Sensitive data is masked before storage during DataWorks data integration.
Engine-layer masking: Directly applies engine-native masking policies (e.g., MaxCompute masking policies).

features.name: 维表
features.description: 支持用户通过可视化的方式创建生产环境的MaxCompute表并导入本地数据，也支持在表格中直接修改MaxCompute表中的数据。
features.descriptionEn: Supports creating MaxCompute tables in production environments via visual interfaces and importing local data; also supports direct editing of MaxCompute table data within spreadsheets.

features.name: 组件管理
features.description: 组件用于将SQL过程抽象为一个SQL模板，实现SQL代码的复用。
features.descriptionEn: Components abstract SQL procedures into reusable SQL templates.

features.name: 数据水印溯源
features.description:
支持对泄露数据进行溯源，追溯可能的泄露行为；
提供泄露行为的发生时间、操作者、执行SQL详情等信息，帮助管理员追溯数据泄露事件。
features.descriptionEn: Supports tracing leaked data to identify potential leakage actions; provides timestamps, operators, and executed SQL details to help administrators investigate data leakage incidents.

features.name: 数据推送及订阅
features.description: 支持配置数据查询结果推送及内容订阅
features.descriptionEn: Supports configuring data query result push and content subscription.

features.name: 数据目录
features.description: 支持OpenLake湖仓一体架构，实现统一元数据管理，建表方式多样化，辅助智能建表，提升数据研发效率，满足不同类型用户多样化元数据创建及管理的需求。
features.descriptionEn: Supports the OpenLake lakehouse architecture for unified metadata management, offers diverse table creation methods, assists intelligent table creation, enhances data R&D efficiency, and meets varied metadata creation and management needs across user types.

features.name: 敏感数据访问审计
features.description:
支持对用户访问敏感数据的行为进行审计，时间不超过1个月；
提供访问行为发生的时间、操作者、访问数据的明细、执行SQL详情等信息；
features.descriptionEn: Audits user access to sensitive data, retaining logs for up to one month; provides timestamps, operators, accessed data details, and executed SQL information.

features.name: 资源管理
features.description: 支持在您的数据开发代码中引用自定义的资源和函数（支持MaxCompute、EMR、CDH、Flink），支持用户创建或上传资源、函数至目标工作空间，上传后才可在该工作空间的任务中使用。
features.descriptionEn: Supports referencing custom resources and functions (for MaxCompute, EMR, CDH, Flink) in data development code; allows users to create or upload resources and functions to target workspaces, making them available for use in workspace tasks.

features.name: 数据分析和结果管控
features.description:
授权RAM用户在DataWorks数据分析中使用其他身份访问数据源。
管控RAM用户对数据分析结果的下载、导出、分享等行为。
features.descriptionEn: Authorizes RAM users to access data sources in DataWorks Data Analysis using alternative identities; controls RAM users’ download, export, and sharing of analysis results.

features.name: 操作检查
features.description: DataWorks提供了全链路的数据开发治理能力，为您提供了统一的数据开发治理流程，支持您基于自己的业务需求，在关键的流程节点上进行流程管控。
features.descriptionEn: DataWorks provides end-to-end data development governance capabilities, offering a unified governance workflow. Users can implement process controls at critical workflow nodes based on business requirements.

features.name: 实体转交
features.description:
支持设置租户级的转交规则、工作空间的转交规则；
支持手动触发实体转交；
支持自动触发实体转交，例如，删除账号、移除工作空间时自动触发转交规则。
features.descriptionEn: Supports configuring tenant-level and workspace-level transfer rules; supports manual entity transfer triggers; and supports automatic transfers—for example, triggered upon account deletion or workspace removal.

features.name: 身份凭证管理
features.description: 支持将阿里云RAM子账号映射为数据源自身的用户，实现RAM子账号使用指定的用户身份访问数据源中的库/表/列数据。
features.descriptionEn: Maps Alibaba Cloud RAM sub-accounts to native users of data sources, enabling RAM sub-accounts to access databases/tables/columns using specified identities.

features.name: Ranger管理
features.description: 通过对接Ranger实现用户在DataWorks申请和审批Starrocks和Hive的数据访问控制权限。
features.descriptionEn: Integrates with Ranger to enable RAM users to request and approve data access control permissions for StarRocks and Hive in DataWorks.

features.name: 个人开发环境
features.description: 个人开发环境支持对接用户NAS、Git、支持Python编程与Notebook。
features.descriptionEn: The personal development environment supports integration with user NAS, Git, Python programming, and Notebook.

features.name: 平台安全基线检查
features.description: 支持基于数据“采集、传输、存储、计算、分享”等多方面进行安全监测，并提供用户改进建议。
features.descriptionEn: Supports security monitoring across data collection, transmission, storage, computation, and sharing, and provides improvement recommendations.

features.name: Agent
features.description: DataWorks Agent基于MCP协议（模型上下文协议），可对接DataWorks MCP Server及其他大数据MCP Server（如Hologres MCP Server），旨在通过自然语言交互在DataWorks中实现数据开发、任务运维和数据集成等能力。
features.descriptionEn: DataWorks Agent, built on the MCP (Model Context Protocol), connects to the DataWorks MCP Server and other big-data MCP Servers (e.g., Hologres MCP Server), enabling natural-language-driven data development, task O&M, and data integration within DataWorks.

agents.billingLogic:
DataWorks Data Agent 采用包年包月与按量付费相结合的计费方式，开通即享赠送Token额度，超出后自动按量计费。
体验版：免费，用于功能试用。
个人版：¥69/月，面向个人开发者。
团队版：¥149/席位/月，专为企业团队设计。
当每席位赠送的 Token 额度耗尽后，系统将依据每次请求的实际 Token 消耗量进行按量计费。

计费规则：按量费用 = 输入 Token 数量 × 输入单价 + 输出 Token 数量 × 输出单价

详细的计费说明：https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dataworks/dataworks-data-agent-agent-billing?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-72772.d_2_1_1.793213ae9Gkm9n

agents.name: ESA AI助手
agents.description: ESA控制台上的AI助手，用于解答问题、诊断异常、配置实例、生成页面等。
agents.descriptionEn: An AI assistant in the ESA console for answering questions, diagnosing issues, configuring instances, generating pages, and more.

features.name: 智能问答
features.description: 以千问大模型为底座，配合ESA产品的官方帮助文档、openapi文档知识库，为用户提供对话式的ESA产品知识问答能力，只回答与ESA产品相关的问题。
features.descriptionEn: Built on the Qwen large language model and integrated with the official ESA product documentation and OpenAPI documentation knowledge base, this feature provides conversational Q&A capabilities for ESA product knowledge, answering only questions related to ESA products.

features.name: 智能诊断
features.description: Agent通过调用skill以及MCP等工具去诊断各类异常问题，例如：证书异常、访问异常、openapi报错、流量盗刷等。
features.descriptionEn: An agent diagnoses various anomalies—such as certificate errors, access failures, OpenAPI errors, and traffic theft—by invoking skills and tools like MCP.

features.name: 域名迁移
features.description: 帮助用户把CDN/DCDN域名的配置映射为ESA站点的配置，并且完成站点添加、配置下发等相关流程。
features.descriptionEn: Assists users in mapping CDN/DCDN domain configurations to ESA site configurations and completing related workflows, including site creation and configuration deployment.

features.name: 智能配置
features.description: 能够理解客户的业务需求，并转化为对应的功能配置，实现例如：创建站点、添加DNS记录、部署pages等功能配置。
features.descriptionEn: Understands customers’ business requirements and translates them into corresponding functional configurations—for example, creating sites, adding DNS records, and deploying Pages.

agents.name: Hologres-Agent 企业数据分析
agents.description: 面向企业数据团队与业务分析师，将自然语言问题锚定到指标口径与表结构，自动完成取数、异常诊断、归因分析和报告生成。
agents.descriptionEn: Helps enterprise data and analytics teams turn natural-language questions into grounded analysis: resolve metrics, retrieve data, diagnose anomalies, attribute changes, and produce reports.

features.name: SQL开发
features.description: 兼容PostgreSQL语法，支持完整的DDL、DML等能力，提供多种数据类型和函数，可标准的SQL开发，上手成本低。

features.name: 引擎扩展能力
features.description: 提供多种扩展函数，满足流量分析、空间计算、向量计算等多个场景更加低成本的分析计算，包含：PostGIS扩展、Proxima向量计算、Oracle扩展函数、ClickHouse扩展函数、聚合函数、流量分析函数。

features.name: Hologres Binlog
features.description: 支持单表级别的Binlog，用于记录表数据的修改记录。通过Hologres Binlog，实现数仓分层间的全链路实时开发，缩短数据端到端加工延迟，同时提升数据开发效率。

features.name: 实时物化视图
features.description: 实时物化视图将对明细表的数据进行预先聚合，存储为物化视图，通过查询物化视图，减少计算量，显著提升查询性能。

features.name: JSON和JSON列存
features.description: 支持JSON和JSONB数据类型、多种JSON函数，满足标签、画像等场景对半结构化数据分析的需求。同时支持JSONB列式存储，实现JSON数据更高的存储压缩，更低的查询延迟。

features.name: Explain& Explain Analyze
features.description: Hologres会为每个执行的SQL生成执行计划，可以通过Explain和Explain Analyze查看算子含义，进一步辅助优化sql。

features.name: 内表多种存储模式和存储介质
features.description:
1.存储模式上，业务可根据需求选择存储模式，包含：列存、行存、行列共存；行存满足高QPS点查场景、列存支持高性能多维分析、行列共存支持行存和列存的混合查询场景。
2.存储介质上：支持按需将数据进行冷热分层存储，实现更加低成本的数据存储，包含：冷热分层存储。

features.name: 数据湖等外表存储
features.description: 可直接访问存储MaxCompute、OSS上的数据，实现离线数据加速，数据湖数据加速，包含：OSS存储、MaxCompute存储。

features.name: HoloWeb
features.description: Holoweb是基于Hologres引擎的可视化数据库管理和开发一站式平台，灵活适用于数据库管理、数据库接入、数据开发、数据分析、性能分析和诊断等用户场景。

features.name: DataWorks
features.description: DataWorks是阿里云的一站式开发平台，提供数据开发、数据集成、数据服务、数据地图等能力，Hologres与DataWorks深度集成，可以直接绑定Hologres实例进行一站式实时数仓开发，满足业务的不同场景开发和管理需求。

features.name: Hologres Client
features.description: HoloClient是在JDBC基础上自研的开发接口，可实现自动攒批、自动路由分区、消费Binlog等功能，满足业务的高性能大批量数据写入、高QPS点查和维表关联场景。

features.name: JDBC/ODBC
features.description: Hologres提供标准JDBC/ODBC接口，可实现应用低成本直连Hologres。

features.name: PSQL/PGAdmin客户端
features.description: Hologres兼容PostgreSQL，可以直接连接PG标准客户端，如PSQL、PGAdmin等客户端。

features.name: Flink、Spark等Connector
features.description: Hologres提供多种数据写入Connector，与Flink、Spark等计算框架原生集成，通过内置Connector，支持大数据实时写入与更新。

features.name: BI分析工具
features.description: 可与多种BI工具如Quick BI、Tableau、Datav等无缝对接，实现数据的高性能分析。

features.name: Flink实时写入与读取
features.description: 1.Hologres作为Flink结果表，实现直接实时写入、（整行、局部）更新写入Hologres；2.Hologres作为Flink维表，实现高性能Flink维表关联查询。3.Hologres可作为Flink源表，实现CDC读取、全增量读等。满足一站式实时数仓建设。

features.name: Kafka实时写入
features.description: 提供多种方式将Kafka数据投递至Hologres，包括Flink写入、DataWorks数据集成写入以及Hologres Connector等。

features.name: MySQL、PostgreSQL等数据库整库实时同步

agents.name: MaxAgent
agents.description: MaxCompute AI 助手，辅助大数据开发、查询、分析与平台使用，并提供多轮对话与问答功能，以及数据方面的支持。
agents.descriptionEn: MaxAgent assists with big data development, querying, analysis, and platform usage, and provides multi-turn conversations and Q&A, as well as data  assistance.
agents.subCategoryName: 云原生大数据计算服务 MaxCompute

features.name: 计算资源配置优化
features.description: 当您需要在保证作业完成的前提下降低包年包月规格计算资源的费用或遇到基于现有资源配置作业完成时间达不到预期的情况时，MaxCompute为您提供计算成本优化功能，可基于实际作业请求量和资源配置期望，对包年包月一级Quota类型的计算资源生成更优的资源配置方案，也支持查看当前使用按量付费计算资源的项目调整为使用包年包月计算资源的资源配置推荐方案及效果推演，帮助您进一步优化计算成本和提高资源利用效率。
features.descriptionEn: When you need to reduce the cost of subscription-based compute resources while ensuring job completion, or when jobs cannot meet expected completion times with current resource configurations, MaxCompute provides a compute cost optimization feature. Based on actual job request volumes and desired resource configurations, it generates optimized configuration plans for subscription-based Quota-level compute resources. It also supports recommending and simulating the migration of projects currently using pay-as-you-go compute resources to subscription-based compute resources, helping you further optimize compute costs and improve resource utilization efficiency.

features.name: 分层存储配置优化
features.description: MaxCompute支持通过设置表或分区的分层存储类型，降低数据存储费用。MaxCompute提供分层存储配置优化功能，可基于表的最近访问时间，根据默认策略或自定义策略评估当前地域是否有存储降本空间，辅助您进行分层存储策略配置。
features.descriptionEn: MaxCompute supports reducing data storage costs by configuring tiered storage types for tables or partitions. The tiered storage configuration optimization feature evaluates potential storage cost savings in the current region based on the most recent access time of tables, using either default or custom policies, thereby assisting you in configuring optimal tiered storage strategies.

features.name: 物化视图推荐与管理
features.description: 为了提高用户的计算效率、减少重复计算，同时加速用户计算。MaxCompute提供物化视图智能计算加速，为您智能分析推荐创建物化视图。
features.descriptionEn: To improve computational efficiency, reduce redundant computation, and accelerate query performance, MaxCompute provides intelligent materialized view-based acceleration, automatically analyzing and recommending materialized view creation.

features.name: 自动物化视图（AutoMV）
features.description: 随着MaxCompute的深入使用，会出现对MaxCompute表执行多次重复查询的情况，并且不同使用者之间互不知晓对方也在采用相同的计算逻辑。为了提高用户的计算效率、减少重复计算，同时加速用户计算，MaxCompute提供自动物化视图（AutoMV）能力，根据用户作业查询习惯和性能自动创建物化视图。
features.descriptionEn: As MaxCompute usage deepens, repeated queries against the same tables become common, often without users being aware of each other’s identical computational logic. To improve computational efficiency, reduce redundant computation, and accelerate query performance, MaxCompute provides Automatic Materialized Views (AutoMV), which automatically creates materialized views based on user query patterns and performance requirements.

agents.billingLogic: 按Credits消耗计费，中国站有Credits包（100、500、1000、5000、10000Credits包），用户可选包用尽按量计费。1Credits中国站单价0.08元、国际站单价0.01美元，主要抵扣tokens，抵扣逻辑主要是等值抵扣：1次请求消耗的Credits=产生的tokenc费用*1.2/Crdits单价。
agents.billingLogicEn: MaxAgent is billed in Credits. Credit charges primarily cover token usage and compute resource consumption by MaxAgent instances, but do not include costs incurred by tasks submitted to engines for execution — for example, the cost of running SQL queries through the "Smart Data Retrieval" module. You must first activate the Standard Edition before you can use MaxAgent features. Once the Standard Edition is activated, you can purchase Credits packages of various specifications on demand.

agents.name: OSS Agent
agents.description: 通过自然语言完成 Bucket 管理、异常诊断、健康巡检和费用分析，并支持对 Bucket 中多模态数据进行语义检索与直接对话
agents.descriptionEn: Uses natural language for Bucket management, exception diagnostics, health inspections, and cost analysis, and supports semantic retrieval and direct conversations over multimodal data in Buckets.

features.name: 异常排查
features.description: OSS Agent 面向 403 拒绝、请求报错等异常，支持自然语言描述或粘贴 RequestId/错误码，自动解析根因（权限缺失、防盗链、公共读盗刷等），定位到具体 Bucket、时间段与 Top 来源 IP，并给出可一键执行的止血方案，将原本 20-40 分钟的人工排查压缩至分钟级。
features.descriptionEn: OSS Agent supports natural language descriptions or pasting RequestId/error codes to automatically diagnose root causes (e.g., insufficient permissions, hotlink protection misconfiguration, unauthorized public reads) for anomalies such as HTTP 403 Forbidden errors and request failures. It pinpoints the specific Bucket, time range, and top source IPs, and provides actionable, one-click remediation plans—reducing manual troubleshooting time from 20–40 minutes to minutes.

features.name: 健康巡检
features.description: OSS Agent 对客户 Bucket 进行多维度自动体检，覆盖 ACL 权限、防盗链、BlockPublicAccess、加密、版本控制、日志投递等安全项，输出量化安全评分与扣分明细，识别公共读写等风险点，并针对每项给出加固建议与配置引导，帮助客户主动发现隐患而非事后补救。
features.descriptionEn: OSS Agent performs multi-dimensional automated health checks on customer Buckets, covering security configurations including ACL permissions, hotlink protection, BlockPublicAccess, encryption, versioning, and log delivery. It delivers a quantified security score with detailed deduction breakdowns, identifies risk points such as public read/write access, and provides tailored hardening recommendations and configuration guidance—enabling proactive risk detection rather than post-incident remediation.

features.name: 管控配置
features.description: OSS Agent 识别"帮我配置"类自然语言指令，覆盖 Bucket 所有管控配置，如防盗链、创建bucket、acl等配置。创建采用 5 步结构化思考与默认配置表格，高危操作强制拦截、中危二次确认。
features.descriptionEn: OSS Agent interprets natural language commands such as 'help me configure' to support all Bucket management configurations—including hotlink protection, bucket creation, and ACL settings. Configuration follows a structured 5-step reasoning process with default configuration tables; high-risk operations are forcibly blocked, while medium-risk operations require secondary confirmation.

features.setName: 多模态数据检索与对话 （Talk to bucket）
features.name: OSS 多模态数据对话
features.description: OSS Agent 支持对 Bucket 内图片、音视频、文档等多模态数据进行自然语言语义检索，覆盖 IPC 安防监控异常事件检索、媒资内容检索、多格式文档检索等场景。用户以对话方式描述需求即可精准定位目标对象。
features.setNameEn: Multimodal Data Search and Dialogue (Talk to Bucket)
features.descriptionEn: OSS Agent enables natural language semantic search across multimodal data stored in Buckets—including images, audio/video files, and documents—supporting use cases such as IPC surveillance anomaly event retrieval, media asset content search, and cross-format document search. Users simply describe their needs conversationally to precisely locate target objects.
